definition_quote.value: 'Practice of engineering' or 'practice of professional engineering' means any of the following when done for others: performing a service or creating an original work requiring engineering education, training and experience; applying special knowledge of the mathematical, physical and engineering sciences to services or original works such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, and services during construction, manufacture or fabrication.
